statement: Raja Yoga (a kendra-house lord and a trikona-house lord connected by conjunction, aspect, or sign exchange) is traditionally read as carrying a structural elevation in status and authority — the classical template most other named 'success' yogas build on, strength scaling with the dignity of the planets involved.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
